card.title: Protection Through Silence
card.instruction: Protect others by withholding details, redirecting questions, and managing timing because you trust your own judgment about when the truth should surface.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the last page of the review after your concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it say anything about my voice?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It says things you don't need to carry onto a stage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give it to me in the interval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's before your solo. I'll bring you water in the interval. Water hasn't formed an opinion.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 withholds the review until after performance, A3 refuses voice details as burdens, and A5 overrides B's interval compromise to protect the solo.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's voice question causes A3's burden framing; B4's interval proposal makes A5 identify the remaining solo and substitute water.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants relevant feedback and B4 proposes a less disruptive time to receive it.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's timing concession to refine the protective delay around the solo and offer an innocuous substitute.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a review and upcoming concert; B2 specifies the performance concern.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's water-has-no-opinion line is earned by B4's interval and the withheld review.

coach2.stated: A5 explicitly places the solo after the interval; this is relevant new schedule information rather than an unexplained prior event.
coach2.inferred: A1-B4 establish a performer and someone controlling access to a review.
coach2.missing: No essential gap; the actual critical judgment is deliberately withheld.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory defect; A manages when truth should surface under a protective rationale.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 asks about the content A1 delays.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 answers B2 indirectly by saying it should not be carried onto stage.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 proposes receiving it at the interval instead.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 rejects B4's time because the solo follows and offers water.
